first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify its downstream revenue quality and compare it with onboarding simplification, given the concurrent completion decline. Until verified, limit exposure because discount-driven gains may not translate into sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current onboarding decline while supporting sustainable revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure: its verified qualified-revenue lift came with 30-day retention down 12%, indicating poor downstream value. Current-period impact remains uncertain, so retain an experimental holdout rather than rolling out broadly.
